checked.claim: CNPD fine 15 July 2021; Tribunal administratif dismissed appeal 18 March 2025; Amazon appealed further
checked.evidence: 2B Advice: CNPD decision 15 July 2021, Administrative Tribunal 18 March 2025 dismissed Amazon's appeal; further appeal confirmed by the Cour administrative judgment of 12 March 2026.

checked.claim: 12 March 2026 Cour administrative annulled decision and fine for lack of fault analysis and alternatives; referred back; compliance order moot as Amazon switched to consent
checked.evidence: CNPD: court 'quasi-intégralement validé l'approche de la CNPD' but annulled the fine; compliance order moot as Amazon had achieved 'mise en conformité effective' before the hearing; CNPD 'poursuivra l'instruction du dossier'. PPC Land: case 52757C, fault not analysed per Deutsche Wohnen and NVSC, full range of sanctions not evaluated, referred back. No source says Amazon switched to consent. Judgment PDF returned 403, so whether the whole decision or only the fine was annulled could not be read.
checked.replacement: On 12 March 2026 the Administrative Court largely confirmed CNPD's findings of breach but annulled the EUR 746 million fine, because CNPD had not assessed whether Amazon acted intentionally or negligently (as the CJEU required in C-807/21 and C-683/21) and had not weighed alternatives to a fine. The case was sent back to CNPD, which said it would continue the case; the compliance order was moot as Amazon had already brought its practices into compliance. No further appeal exists.
